transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get the final-clearance meeting for the 'Tidal Memory' international teaser underway. We've got a 60-second spot to lock, and the draft edit is built around either 'Midnight Arcade' by Vela North or 'Paper Satellites' by Rowan Hale. The draft package currently lists worldwide use, a full-mix excerpt, and a provisional music credit. I need each of you to report your current findings and action items in turn — rights, composer approvals, platform delivery requirements — so we can determine which track is best-supported and compliant. Who wants to start?
